note: Independently re-judged against RFC 4271 Section 8.2.2 OpenSent Event 24's complete four-action list and Section 6.2's Unsupported Version Number definition, with RFC 6608 Section 4 applied to the non-version control. TestRFC4271VersionErrorNotificationReleasesQuietly/OPENSENT starts ConnectRetryCounter at 3, receives NOTIFICATION 2/1 and requires the exact empty outgoing notification list, TCP closure, ConnectRetry/Hold/Keepalive timers stopped, session released and Idle, with counter still 3. The initial value detects both an increment and an erroneous reset; the Event 24 list has no counter increment. The close helper treats a non-timeout read failure as closure, without pinning strict io.EOF. TestRFC4271OtherOpenErrorNotificationIsNotAVersionError/OPENSENT changes only the triggering subcode to 2/2 and requires Event 25's exact 5/1 response and counter 3 to 4 with teardown. Thus an error-code-only version classifier fails. The original buffers and teardown assertions are retained; the approved expectation change is RFC 6608's state diagnostic, not relaxed behavior. notificationEvent selects Event 24 only for 2/1 and handleOpenSent keeps the separate no-increment arm. The renewed negative record observes a clean named-unit pass followed by red under its producer break.
